Storehouse completed.
First night began on day 1.
Raid active with 2 enemies.
THE SHARD LIES W — a frontier marker is within reach.
A rival Claimant Outpost has been sighted on the frontier.
CLAIMANT OUTPOST CAPTURED — their stores are yours. +8 Wood, +4 Stone, +2 Wyrd. Hold the corridor; the rival will return.
Raw Wyrd exposure is rising. Raise a Lumen on the harvester or refine the surplus.
